recipe.title: Moong Dal Chilla

ingredients.name: moong dal ((split & husked yellow moong lentils))
water (– for grinding lentils or add as required)
roasted cumin powder ( or cumin powder (ground cumin))
oil (– for cooking chilla or add as required)

steps.text: Rinse the moong dal 3 to 4 times in water.
steps.label: Rinse dal
consumes_ingredients: moong dal ((split & husked yellow moong lentils))

steps.text: Soak the lentils with 2 to 3 cups of water for 3 to 4 hours or overnight if you plan to make the chilla for breakfast.
steps.label: Soak dal
steps.attention_cue: for 3 to 4 hours or overnight if you plan to make the chilla for breakfast
consumes_ingredients: moong dal ((split & husked yellow moong lentils))
steps.doneness_cue: The moong dal will swell or double up in size

steps.text: The moong dal will swell or double up in size. Discard the water. Rinse the mung lentils again a few times in water. Drain all the water.
steps.label: Drain dal
consumes_ingredients: moong dal ((split & husked yellow moong lentils))

steps.text: In a grinder, add the soaked moong lentils and ¼ cup of water. Grind to a smooth and fine consistency. Don't add too much water as the lentils might not grind evenly. We need a smooth and lump free batter for moong dal chilla.
steps.label: Grind dal
consumes_ingredients: moong dal ((split & husked yellow moong lentils))
water (– for grinding lentils or add as required)

steps.text: Take the finely ground batter in a bowl. Add turmeric powder, red chili powder, cumin powder and salt or as required. Mix very well.
steps.label: Season batter
consumes_ingredients: roasted cumin powder ( or cumin powder (ground cumin))

steps.text: Then add the chopped coriander leaves, chopped onions, grated ginger, finely chopped green chilies and a pinch of asafoetida. Again mix very well.
steps.label: Add mix-ins
steps.doneness_cue: The onions will leave some moisture

steps.text: Allow the batter to rest for 15 to 20 mins.
steps.label: Rest batter
steps.attention_cue: Allow the batter to rest for 15 to 20 mins.

steps.text: Check the consistency of the batter. If it's too thick, then add 1 to 2 tablespoons more water. The consistency of the batter has to be of pouring consistency, neither too thick nor too thin.
steps.label: Adjust consistency
consumes_ingredients: water (– for grinding lentils or add as required)

steps.text: Heat a well seasoned pan. This is important as the pan has to be hot before you make the cheelas. If using a cast iron pan, spread ½ teaspoon of oil evenly on the pan. If using a non-stick pan, do not spread oil on it.
steps.label: Heat pan
consumes_ingredients: oil (– for cooking chilla or add as required)

steps.text: Add a scoopful of batter towards the center of the pan. The batter will spread a little on its own. Just rotate the batter with the back of spatula giving a round and even shape.
steps.label: Spread chilla

steps.text: Cook the chilla on medium heat. After a minute they will look crisp and brown from the bottom.
steps.label: Cook first side
steps.attention_cue: After a minute they will look crisp and brown from the bottom
steps.doneness_cue: look crisp and brown from the bottom

steps.text: At this point drizzle a bit of oil around the edges and in the center of the chilla. Spread the oil drops with a spoon all over the cooked chilla.
steps.label: Oil edges
consumes_ingredients: oil (– for cooking chilla or add as required)

steps.text: Flip the chilla and cook the other side for a minute.
steps.label: Cook other side

steps.text: Once the moong dal chilla appear crisp and golden, remove and place aside. Similarly make all other chilla.
steps.label: Finish chillas

steps.text: You can opt to stuff the chilla with some grated paneer if you want.
steps.label: Stuffing option
steps.role_cue: You can opt to stuff the chilla with some grated paneer if you want.

steps.text: Serve moong dal chilla with tomato ketchup or green chutney.
steps.label: Serve

notes: Steps and wording taken from the linked recipe JSON-LD (vegrecipesofindia.com). I kept ingredient names and quantities exactly as listed there. I created a produced component label "batter" for the grinding/seasoning steps so later steps can reference it. The soaking step includes the written alternative "or overnight"; durations reflect the stated 34 hours and allow a wide max to cover overnight rather than inventing a precise overnight length. The optional stuffing instruction was marked optional with the exact source phrase as role_cue.
